name: Sushi Boat
description: A stunning 25-piece sushi boat crafted with premium sashimi-grade salmon, tuna, and yellowtail. Each roll is hand-pressed with seasoned Japanese rice and wrapped in toasted nori, served with pickled ginger, wasabi, and house ponzu sauce.

name: Grilled Salmon
description: Norwegian Atlantic salmon fillet marinated in lemon herb butter, grilled over open flame to a perfect medium. Served alongside roasted seasonal vegetables, garlic mashed potatoes, and a light dill cream sauce.

name: Wagyu Tenderloin
description: A5 Japanese Wagyu tenderloin, richly marbled and slow-cooked to melt-in-your-mouth perfection. Finished with a red wine reduction, truffle butter, and served with pomme purée and charred broccolini.

name: Truffle Risotto
description: Creamy Arborio rice slow-stirred with aged Parmigiano-Reggiano, dry white wine, and finished with shaved black Périgord truffle. A luxurious vegetarian dish with deep earthy aroma and velvety texture.

name: Omani Shuwa Lamb
description: A celebrated Omani delicacy — whole lamb leg rubbed with a secret blend of saffron, cardamom, and rose water, wrapped in banana leaves and slow-cooked underground for 12 hours. Served with saffron rice and Omani khubz bread.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Warm 70% Valrhona dark chocolate fondant with a molten flowing center, dusted with cocoa powder and served with a quenelle of Madagascar vanilla bean ice cream and fresh raspberry coulis.

name: Lobster Bisque
description: Velvety bisque crafted from whole Maine lobster, slow-simmered with cognac, tarragon, and heavy cream. Garnished with a poached lobster claw, crème fraîche swirl, and micro chervil.

name: Caesar Salad
description: Crisp hearts of romaine tossed in a classic house Caesar dressing made with anchovy, egg yolk, and aged Parmigiano. Topped with house-baked sourdough croutons, shaved Pecorino, and cracked black pepper.
